description: US labor & price statistics from the Bureau of Labor Statistics by friendly name. Available: unemployment_rate, labor_force_participation, employment_population_ratio, cpi, cpi_less_food_energy, nonfarm_payrolls, avg_hourly_earnings, avg_weekly_hours, ppi_final_demand. Returns a monthly time series. Keyless official BLS data.

end_year.description: End year (optional; defaults to current year).

indicator.description: Indicator name, one of: unemployment_rate, labor_force_participation, employment_population_ratio, cpi, cpi_less_food_energy, nonfarm_payrolls, avg_hourly_earnings, avg_weekly_hours, ppi_final_demand.

start_year.description: Start year (optional; defaults to ~3 years back).

name: bls_indicator
